boxes.meaning: magic power; a strong, mysterious pull or charm

examples.english: This necklace has so much spell power that I can fly after putting it on.
examples.traditional: 呢條項鏈好有魔力，我戴咗之後就識飛喇。

examples.english: This song has a kind of magic that makes people listen to it again and again.
examples.traditional: 呢首歌有種魔力，令人一聽再聽。
